text:
tia: Quick design question: where should we surface the invoice CTA and the token breakdown legend on the Usage page? two quick layouts in figma: header CTA + right-side legend vs sticky legend below charts + per-row invoice actions.
omar: Link to mocks: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE
pm_liu: Reminder: enterprise customers want the official invoice very discoverable (prefer header). Product teams like inline per-project exports.
kelly: UX: right-side legend is nice on wide screens but collapses poorly on tablet. If legend is below charts it reads top-to-bottom better on mobile.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: legend must be programmatically associated with the chart (aria-describedby) and use text labels not color-only indicators.
tia: Proposal: show a primary "Download invoice" CTA in the header when Org scope is active. For Project scope, show a small per-row download icon with accessible name. Legend: place compact token breakdown legend under the chart on mobile, right-side on desktop. Ensure visible contrast and focus order.
omar: Token breakdown copy: show both token count and USD equivalent. e.g., "12.3K tokens (≈ $1.24)" — keeps finance and devs happy.
pm_liu: Confirm legal copy: use 'Invoice' for PDFs; 'Export CSV' for CSVs. Good to show microcopy "Official invoice (PDF)" under header CTA.
kelly: Visual note: if we put header CTA plus right legend, chart width shrinks. Might affect sparkline readability. Could make legend collapsible.
a11y-bot: Also ensure toggle for Org/Project announces changes (role=tab recommended) and that per-row icons have aria-labels like "Download invoice for Project Foo".
tia: Action items: omar update figma with responsive legend placements + header CTA microcopy; kelly to prototype collapsible legend; pm_liu to confirm legal microcopy; a11y-bot to add acceptance criteria. I'll mark design-ready once mocks + tickets linked. :white_check_mark:
